title: Qualification evidence and next steps
body:
Archived NotNotes dev15 source and tests are imported byte-exact into Git, verified against the source ZIP for the three core .cls Git blobs. No fresh ooRexx r13196 test or live NotNotes document write was performed in the current session.

Rebuild the complete declared dependency closure; qualify document persistence and cluster fencing under real interpreter; verify write authorization and version fencing; integrate the dev10 proposal against actual NotNotes API; and retain the user-facing v0.6.2 corpus as separate authority.
summary: Archived NotNotes dev15 source and tests are imported byte-exact into Git, verified against the source ZIP for the three core .cls Git blobs. No fresh ooRexx r13196 test or live NotNotes document write was performed in the current session.
invariants: NotNotes alone owns its document truth and revision state
Transport and UI are adapters, not document authorities
No qualification can be assumed from Git source publication

provenance.claim: Exact historical source package; not a newer runtime acceptance
